definition: The q.9 a.2 external channel: a creature depends for esse on the creator's ongoing action and lies within the creator's power to originate or withdraw that esse. This is not the potency IN the creature quantified by the existing PureAct predicate.
note: The same q.9 a.2 sense as DEF-MUTABLE-THROUGH-ANOTHER (DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER), encoded by the same declaration over the typed power relation PowerOver; see that record for examples, counterexamples and structural properties. Kept as a separate record rather than merged (invariant 6).
